**Finding submitted: INSURANCE — missing (confidence 0.9).**

- **Investigation:** Document-wide searches for "insurance" and for coverage/insurer/certificate language returned no hits. All three planner candidates were read: § 5.3 (Security) contains only security-feature commitments and disclaimers, § 14.12 (Risk of Loss) allocates risk of loss for Base and Customer Components with no policy requirement, and § 14.18 (Data Protection) confirms IBM processes personal information on our behalf as part of the Services. "Customer Data" is not a defined term in this Agreement.
- **Classification:** No usable insurance clause exists for a hosting vendor that processes our personal data — walk-away territory, so treated as missing with an insert.
- **Cure:** One `insert_after` § 14.19 adding a single preferred-level clause: CGL USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate, E&O USD 2M, cyber and privacy USD 5M where IBM processes, stores or accesses any data belonging to, supplied by, or processed for Customer (comprehensive descriptor, not narrowed examples, and avoiding an undefined term), workers' compensation as required by law, and certificates on request. No survival tail, at-own-expense wording, or other non-element boilerplate was added, and no neighbouring clause was rewritten. Redline validated `ok:true` with the minimality gate clean; all six preferred elements mapped to the single operation.
